CD4+ T cells.rationale: CD4 and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while IL2 and IL7R are associated with T cell activation. CD8A and CD19 are markers for CD8+ T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in CD4+ T cells.

CD8+ T cells.rationale: CD8A and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while GZMB and PRF1 are associated with cytotoxic function. CD4 and CD19 are markers for CD4+ T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in CD8+ T cells.

Regulatory T cells.rationale: FOXP3, CD4, and CD25 are canonical markers for regulatory T cells, while CTLA4 is associated with immune suppression. CD8A and CD19 are markers for CD8+ T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in regulatory T cells.

B cells.rationale: CD19, CD79A, MS4A1, and IGHD are canonical markers for B cells. CD3E and CD8A are markers for T cells and are not expressed in B cells.

Plasma cells.rationale: CD138, XBP1, IGHG1, and IGHG3 are canonical markers for plasma cells. CD19 and CD3E are markers for B cells and T cells respectively, and are not expressed in plasma cells.

NK cells.rationale: NCAM1, KLRD1, NKG7, and PRF1 are canonical markers for NK cells. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in NK cells.

Monocytes/macrophages.rationale: CD68, CD14, CD163, and CSF1R are canonical markers for monocytes/macrophages. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in monocytes/macrophages.

Dendritic cells.rationale: CD11C, CD209, HLA-DRA, and CCR7 are canonical markers for dendritic cells. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in dendritic cells.

Endothelial cells.rationale: PECAM1, CDH5, VEGFR2, and VWF are canonical markers for endothelial cells. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in endothelial cells.

Fibroblasts / CAFs.rationale: ACTA2, COL1A1, FAP, and PDGFRB are canonical markers for fibroblasts/CAFs. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in fibroblasts/CAFs.

Pericytes.rationale: PDGFRB, RGS5, NG2, and CD13 are canonical markers for pericytes. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in pericytes.

Mast cells.rationale: KIT, FCER1A, CPA3, and TPSAB1 are canonical markers for mast cells. CD3E and CD19 are markers for T cells and B cells respectively, and are not expressed in mast cells.
